title: Take & TakeWhile
description: Learn to take elements from collections using Take and TakeWhile operators.

data.text: The `Take` and `TakeWhile` operators return a specified number of elements from the start of a collection.
The `Take()` method returns the specified number of elements starting from the first element.

data.title: Take Example

data.text: The `TakeWhile()` method returns elements as long as the specified condition is true. Once the condition becomes false, it stops returning elements.

data.title: TakeWhile Example
data.content: Taking elements while condition is true

data.text: The second overload of `TakeWhile` includes the index of each element:

data.title: TakeWhile with Index
data.content: Taking based on element and index

data.title: Not Supported in Query Syntax
data.text: Take and TakeWhile are not supported in C# query syntax. Use method syntax only.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Take returns a specified number of elements from the start
TakeWhile returns elements while condition is true
Once TakeWhile condition becomes false, stops returning elements
